ul.li: Skip to start ( << ) : Skip to the beginning of the animation.
Step backwards ( < ) : Step backwards one step in the animation.
Step forward ( > ) : Step forward one step in the animation.
Skip to end ( >> ) : Skip to the end of the animation.
Auto Step Speed Set to anything other than off to automatically step through the animation at the selected speed.
Control + D Describe the current state of the data structure. (Only in screen readers.)
